name: LuxPrompter
subtitle: A private teleprompter camera source
description: Install and update LuxPrompter through AltStore Classic.

apps.name: LuxPrompter
apps.subtitle: Record on camera while reading your script.
apps.localizedDescription: A local-first camera teleprompter with adjustable text, scrolling speed, normal and Cinematic capture, and on-device video review.

versions.localizedDescription: New Teleprompter Mode: pick Normal or Teleprompter when the app opens. Teleprompter Mode shows the script full screen on black, with mirror flip buttons, tap to play and pause, a 5-second countdown from the top, and on-screen speed and text size buttons.
New landscape layout: the script sits in a strip beside the camera and the controls move into a box on the other side.
Adds landscape support: turn the phone sideways to film in landscape.
Tap the prompter to play or pause, with smoother speed control near 100% and new ±1% buttons.
Moves the prompter flush to the top edge and relocates camera controls to the bottom.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: LuxPrompter uses the camera to record your videos.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: LuxPrompter records audio with your videos.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: LuxPrompter saves completed videos to your Photos library.
